sections.title: Upper Division Requirements

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Students complete a minimum of 28 upper division communication units, including at least one upper division CMNS "W" course.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: At least two regularly scheduled CMNS 400-level courses.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Directed study and field placement courses may not be used to meet this requirement.

sections.note: Students may enroll in upper division only when prerequisites have been completed.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: The School of Communication requires that a minimum of 20 upper division CMNS units (five CMNS upper division courses, including at least one 400 division CMNS course) must be taken at SFU.

requirements.title: Check with an advisor
requirements.text: Directed study and field placement courses may not be used to meet this requirement.

sections.title: Elective Courses
sections.note: In addition to the courses listed above, students should consult an academic advisor to plan the remaining required elective courses.

grades.label: Continuance Requirements
grades.text: A minimum 2.25 CMNS GPA and 2.00 CGPA is required to remain in good standing in the program.
